Definition: to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to destroy, corrupt, go to ruin, decay; 1a) (Niphal) to be marred, be spoiled, be corrupted, be corrupt, be injured, be ruined, be rotted; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to spoil, ruin; 1b2) to pervert, corrupt, deal corruptly (morally); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to spoil, ruin, destroy; 1c2) to pervert, corrupt (morally); 1c3) destroyer (participle); 1d) (Hophal) spoiled, ruined (participle)
